crossRefs.note: So although I wrote to you, I wrote not for his cause that did the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered the wrong…
For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be made to grieve…
But if any has caused sorrow, he has caused sorrow, not to me, but in part (that I not press too heavily) to you all.
For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority…
I don’t write these things to shame you, but to admonish you as my beloved children.
For though you have ten thousand tutors in Christ, you don’t have many fathers. For in Christ Jesus, I became your…
Our mouth is open to you, Corinthians. Our heart is enlarged.
You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted by your own affections.
You are our letter, written in our hearts, known and read by all men,
Why? Because I don’t love you? God knows.
I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?
For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.
This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,
Ruth said, “Don’t urge me to leave you, and to return from following you, for where you go, I will go; and where you…
Where you die, I will die, and there I will be buried. May Yahweh do so to me, and more also, if anything but death…
Even so, affectionately longing for you, we were well pleased to impart to you, not the Good News of God only, but also…

translations.web: I say this not to condemn you, for I have said before that you are in our hearts to die together and live together.
translations.bsb: I do not say this to condemn you. I have said before that you so occupy our hearts that we live and die together with you.
translations.kjv: I speak not this to condemn you: for I have said before, that ye are in our hearts to die and live with you.
translations.asv: I say it not to condemn you: for I have said before, that ye are in our hearts to die together and live together.
